headerDisplay: Control your Nimbio cellular gate from Apple HomeKit. Paste a live API key from the Nimbio portal below — Homebridge stores it securely in your config.
footerDisplay: After saving, restart Homebridge. Your gate will appear in the Apple Home app.

name.title: Name
name.description: Label for this plugin in Homebridge logs.

apiKey.title: Nimbio API Key
apiKey.description: Live API key from the Nimbio portal (starts with nimbio_live_). This is the only secret you need.

autoCloseSeconds.title: Seconds until HomeKit shows Closed
autoCloseSeconds.description: Most Nimbio homeowner setups cannot report when the gate physically closes. Set this to match your opener’s hardware auto-close (often about 15 seconds) so the Home app returns to Closed on its own.

pulseOnClose.title: Also pulse when closing
pulseOnClose.description: Turn this on if your gate needs a second remote press to close. Most users can leave this off.
